concept.title: About the plugin
concept.shortdesc: The org.istanduk.gov-uk plugin adds a govuk output format to the DITA Open Toolkit that publishes your DITA content as a complete, self-contained static website styled with the GOV.UK Design System.

conbody.p: One command turns a DITA map or bookmap into a website: every page carries the Design System's typography, components, and accessibility behaviour, together with a sidebar navigation tree, a styled home page, and a footer. There is no server-side runtime — the output is plain files you can host anywhere.
The plugin builds on the toolkit's standard html5 processing, so everything DITA offers for content management works unchanged:

ul.li: maps and bookmaps, including chapter structure, book titles, and metadata
key-based addressing (keydef, keyref) at any scale
content reuse with conref, and conditional builds with DITAVAL
page merging with chunk="to-content" and navigation control with toc="no"
the SVG domain for scalable diagrams, as shown in the figure above

conbody.note: The GOV.UK crown and the GDS Transport typeface are legally restricted to official GOV.UK services. This plugin's default output is deliberately neutral — Design System layout and components with system fonts and no crown. See before changing that.

section.title: How to read the demonstrations
section.p: Each topic in the demonstrations chapter pairs the DITA markup you write with the rendered result you are looking at, so authors can see exactly what the styling does to their content.
